name: SUNLU PLA Lite @BBL A1
filament_notes:
SUNLU manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 50 C.
Manufacturer max speed 200 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 18 mm3/s (printer profile 12) from the manufacturer's 200 mm/s rating.
Temperature set for ~200 mm/s on this printer: 225 C (first layer 205 C). Manufacturer bands: 200-210 C at 50-100 mm/s; 210-240 C at 100-200 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
Product page: 200-210C @50-100, 210-240C @100-200mm/s. CONFLICT: wiki lists PLA Lite as 200-260C / <=450mm/s. Shore (HA/HD) 80. Wiki: fan ON, drying 50C.
Source: https://www.sunlu.com/products/pla-lite-filament
